title: In Due Time, the Seasons Change and the Snow Melts
overview: After Yukino announced that she was ready to name her request to the Service Club, a long silence followed… but that silence is about to broken.

title: That Key Was Never Handled Until Today
overview: Isshiki approaches the Service Club with and interesting proposition, but Yukino would like to handle this time-sensitive challenge on her own.

title: Iroha Isshiki is the Strongest Junior, as Expected
overview: What is a prom, exactly? Yukino and Iroha have a plan to show both Hachiman and the student body the answer to that question… with Yui’s help, of course!

title: By Chance, Yui Yuigahama Thinks of the Future
overview: The Student Council’s prom plans sour after a shocking school policy reversal — and to make matters worse, an unexpectedly familiar messenger delivers the bad news.

title: Shizuka Hiratsuka Deeply Longs for the Days Past
overview: Hachiman is determine to help bring the prom to life, but Yukino isn’t keen on accepting his help. Luckily Hachiman has a plan — one that uniquely involves the Service Club.

title: Once again, Hachiman Hikigaya Makes a Speech
overview: First step in Hachiman’s plan? Rally the troops! Together they’ll create a prom proposal so awful, the PTO will have no choice but to choose Yukino’s instead.

title: Until the End, Yui Yuigahama Will Continue Watching Over Them
overview: For Hachiman’s plan to succeed, they’ll need allies from other schools. Communicating with those allies, however, is easier said than done…

title: Wishing That, at the Very Least, I Don't Make Any More Mistakes
overview: Pushing a dummy event like a second prom is a great idea on Hachiman’s part, but the tactic isn’t foolproof against Yukino’s mother. Good thing he has an ace up his sleeve…

title: A Whiff of That Fragrance Will Always Bring Memories of That Season
overview: Hachiman has a new objective: granting Yui’s wish. First step? Help her bake something delicious for Komachi, and perhaps include Yui’s mom’s “secret ingredient.”

title: Gallantly, Shizuka Hiratsuka Moves Forward
overview: Will prom succeed without a hitch? Or is the real trouble lying in wait once prom comes to an end?

title: Only a Heated Touch Truly Conveys the Sentiment
overview: Now that the club has disbanded, they’ll continue to drift even further apart — but before they do, Yui has one final wish to make.

title: My Teen Romantic Comedy Is Wrong, As I Expected
overview: One final hurdle, and the prom situation will finally be over… but will Hachiman’s search for something genuine be so easily resolved?
